title.narrative: Less powerful stakeholders (smallholders, pastoralists, women, ethnic minorities CSOs) use LMI data and information to voice their stakes and participate in negotiating land deals and in policy processes regarding LSLA

description.narrative: Less powerful stakeholders (smallholders, pastoralists, women, ethnic minorities CSOs) use LMI data and information to voice their stakes and participate in negotiating land deals and in policy processes regarding LSLA

comment.narrative: In several countries the LMI provided support to community members on mapping of the boundaries of land deals. In Philippines through the National Land Observatory we helped map out the land area and territory of the Indigenous tribes and created a timeline based on the land acquisitions and expansions of the Jewelmer Corporations pearl farm. We also mapped out the area belonging to the ancestral domain of the Palawan and Molbog tribes to show and prove that there are existing people and tribes living in the area contrary to the statement of the operating company that only pearl farmers who work with Jewelmer are living in the area and that no one will get displaced.This community map was used as a tool for negotiating with the Department of Agrarian Reform DAR to reinforce the need to redistribute and give back the land to the Indigenous Peoples and local community.Provided an important resource OGIEK Peoples Ancestral Territories Atlas to ILCs National Land Coalition in Kenya to document and support the struggle against eviction announce by the president of Kenya in September 2023 of the Ogiek people for their ancestral land.
610 per year average 8 per year 32 in 4 years

description.narrative: Less powerful stakeholders (smallholders, pastoralists, women, ethnic minorities CSOs) use LMI data and information to voice their stakes and participate in negotiating land deals and in policy processes regarding LSLA

comment.narrative: In several countries the LMI provided support to community members on mapping of the boundaries of land deals. In Philippines through the National Land Observatory we helped map out the land area and territory of the Indigenous tribes and created a timeline based on the land acquisitions and expansions of the Jewelmer Corporations pearl farm. We also mapped out the area belonging to the ancestral domain of the Palawan and Molbog tribes to show and prove that there are existing people and tribes living in the area contrary to the statement of the operating company that only pearl farmers who work with Jewelmer are living in the area and that no one will get displaced.This community map was used as a tool for negotiating with the Department of Agrarian Reform DAR to reinforce the need to redistribute and give back the land to the Indigenous Peoples and local community.Provided an important resource OGIEK Peoples Ancestral Territories Atlas to ILCs National Land Coalition in Kenya to document and support the struggle against eviction announce by the president of Kenya in September 2023 of the Ogiek people for their ancestral land.
610 per year average 8 per year 32 in 4 years
